note: Mission data for Wire Squad. Values flagged unverified come from community sources or low-resolution images; see SPEC.md section 14.

missions.title: Training, Day 1
missions.lesson: Lesson 1: How to cut a wire?
rules: No Equipment cards in this mission.
Every player still has one personal Double Detector, even when no Equipment cards are dealt.
missions.success: The team learns to trust the sorted stands. Every wire is cut.
missions.failure: A wrong cut rattles the team. Deal again and retry the lesson.

missions.title: Training, Day 2
missions.lesson: Lesson 2: How to cut a YELLOW wire
rules: Yellow wires have no number. All of them are simply YELLOW.
A yellow wire can only be cut by pairing it with a yellow wire of your own during a Dual Cut.
Yellow Info tokens cannot be used during setup.
missions.success: Both yellow wires are gone and nobody called out a number.
missions.failure: A yellow wire was mistaken for a numbered wire. Deal again.

missions.title: Training, Day 3
missions.lesson: Lesson 3: How (NOT) to cut a RED wire
rules: Never point at a red wire. Pointing at red detonates the bomb.
Red wires are removed with Reveal Your Red Wires once every wire left in that player's hand is red. Both stands count.
If Walkie-Talkies or Equal Label is drawn during setup, discard it and draw a replacement.
missions.success: The red wire is exposed without a single mistake.
missions.failure: The red wire was cut. The bomb goes off and the lesson repeats.

missions.title: First Day in the Field
missions.lesson: Everything you learned, on one bomb.
rules: This mission uses every blue wire.
Cut both yellow wires by pairing them with yellow wires of your own. With two players there are four yellow wires: cut them two by two.
The single red wire can never be cut. A player may reveal red wires only when every wire left in their hand (both stands) is red.
missions.success: The field team clears its first real bomb.
missions.failure: The red wire went off. Reset the wires and try again.

missions.title: Second Day in the Field
rules: Before dealing, draw three yellow wires and mark all three values with the question side up.
Shuffle those three face down, add two of them to the blue pile, and set the third aside unseen.
Both yellow wires must be cut by pairing them with yellow wires of your own.
missions.success: Two of three possibilities, and the right two.
missions.failure: The team guessed wrong one time too many.

missions.title: Third Day in the Field
missions.lesson: Four yellow wires, one red wire.
rules: All four yellow wires are in play and must be paired off.
missions.success: Four yellows cleared without touching the red.

missions.title: Last Day of Class
missions.lesson: One red wire out of two.
rules: Draw two red wires, mark both values, keep one and set the other aside unseen.
No yellow wires are in this mission.
missions.success: Class dismissed with a clean board.
missions.failure: One mistake too many. The final exam waits.

missions.title: Final Exam
rules: Apply every rule learned so far.
Two of three yellow values are in play. One of two red values is in play.
missions.success: The team becomes an official BOMB BUSTERS squad. The first Surprise box is unlocked.
missions.failure: Luckily it was a fake bomb. Study some more and retake the test.

missions.title: A Sense of Priorities
missions.lesson: Some wires must be cut in a set order.
rules: Draw 3 Number cards and lay them face up in a row.
Cut 2 wires of the first card's value before any wire of the second card's value.
Cut 2 wires of the second card's value before any wire of the third card's value.
All other values can be cut in any order.
If a player holds only wires that are still locked, the bomb explodes.
missions.success: The wires are cut in the right order and the bomb is defused.
missions.failure: A red wire is cut, the dial reaches the skull, or a player is stuck with locked wires.
